title: Postdoc in Acoustics-Based Traffic Sensing
description:
### **Job description**


Join KTH's research in engineering acoustics at the Marcus Wallenberg Laboratory (MWL) and develop the next generation of acoustics-based traffic sensing. Cost-effective roadside microphones, combined with signal processing and machine learning, can provide continuous, real-time information on traffic flows, vehicle types and traffic noise, whereas cities today rely on short and intrusive measurement campaigns.


The position is part of two projects funded by Digital Futures, carried out together with the City of Stockholm, Nacka municipality and other municipalities in the region: a societal innovation project expanding an acoustic sensor network across the Stockholm region, and a proof-of-concept project developing a validated roadside monitoring system. You will build on established testbeds and unique datasets from Stockholm's urban environment.


You will deploy acoustic sensor units in urban environments, develop robust methods for detecting and classifying vehicle pass-bys, from processing on the sensor (edge) to the cloud, validate the results against reference measurements, and make data available through APIs and visualisation tools for municipal users. The position also includes scientific publishing, co-supervising students and contributing to new proposals and innovation activities.

### **Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made.
* Strong background in at least two of the following areas: acoustic measurements, signal processing, machine learning, sensor systems or embedded systems.
* Documented research experience through scientific publications.
* Good programming skills, for example in Python.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in daily work.


As a person, you are curious, independent and motivated by research with practical impact. You demonstrate:

* Teaching abilities
* Awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality
* Independence

**Preferred qualifications**

* A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree, obtained within the last three years prior to the application deadline
* Experience with acoustics-based traffic monitoring or with detection and classification of vehicles from sound.
* Experience deploying sensors or measurement systems in the field over long periods.
* Experience with machine learning for audio or time-series data, including deployment on edge devices.
* Experience with data pipelines, databases, APIs or web-based visualisation.
* Previous collaboration with non-academic stakeholders (municipalities, government agencies, industry).
* Interest in innovation and in the utilisation of research results.


Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.

### **Join us at KTH**

title: Join our DevOps & Platform team in Gothenburg
description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps. We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive. We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow.
  
  

Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create. At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver. We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
  
  

We’re looking for DevOps Engineers to join our client projects. We’re not looking for someone who simply keeps systems running. We want people who enjoy improving delivery workflows, automating manual tasks and building robust, scalable platforms that stand up in production. Whether you’re looking for permanent employment or freelance work, we’re flexible.
  
  

What matters is that you’re keen to build, improve and make an impact. We think you have Several years of experience in DevOps or platform engineering in production environments. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps Strong Linux skills Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP Worked with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation Experience with scripting in Bash, Python or PowerShell A solid understanding of system architecture, networking and security You don’t need to know every tool on the list. We’re looking for someone confident in their skills, curious by nature and motivated to keep learning.
  
  

Even better if you’ve worked with DevSecOps Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or Datadog Building or operating Kubernetes clusters Regulated or security-critical environments The mindset we’re looking for For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills. We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on. You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem.
  
  

You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of. At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together. You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference.
  
  

At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other. In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team. We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

title: Technical Lead – IoT Software Development

description:
*Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.*

 *As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.*

 **About the job**


We are looking for a Technical Lead – IoT Software Development to help build secure, scalable digital solutions that connect Alfa Laval products with customers, service teams, and cloud services. These solutions support remote service, data visualization, performance analytics, and improved equipment efficiency, reliability, compliance, and sustainability.

  

You will combine technical leadership with hands-on software development. You will translate business and customer needs into robust technical solutions, guide implementation, support architectural and technical decisions, and help ensure quality throughout the software lifecycle. Working with developers, Product Owners, Delivery Leads, business stakeholders, and DevOps teams, you will influence technical direction and support the delivery of reliable, maintainable, and secure solutions.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Define technical solutions, implementation approaches, estimates, and technical dependencies.
* Guide and mentor developers through technical discussions, code reviews, testing, and engineering best practices.
* Contribute hands-on to software development and technical problem solving.
* Support the complete software lifecycle, from development and deployment to maintenance and operational handover.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for performance, stability, usability, maintainability, and cybersecurity.

 **Who are you**


You are an experienced and hands-on software engineer who enjoys combining technical leadership with active development. You are structured, self-motivated, and able to balance strategic thinking with attention to detail. You take initiative, communicate clearly, and work collaboratively across teams to move technical decisions and delivery forward. You also enjoy mentoring others and influencing through dialogue, knowledge sharing, and sound technical judgment rather than formal authority.

 **What you know**


You have a strong background in software development and experience designing, delivering, and supporting reliable software solutions. You are comfortable taking technical responsibility while remaining close to the code and the development team.

  

To succeed in this role, you will need:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of software development experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with C# and .NET/.NET Core.
* Experience designing and delivering backend or distributed systems, APIs, and service-based architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Microsoft Azure.
* Experience working in Agile software development teams.
* Experience mentoring developers and coordinating technical dependencies across teams.
* Experience with deployment, maintenance, monitoring, logging, diagnostics, and troubleshooting of production systems.

  

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

* IoT, edge, telemetry, cloud-connected, or industrial monitoring solutions.
* Microservices, messaging, or event-driven systems.
* Linux-based environments or time-series databases such as TimescaleDB or InfluxDB.
* Angular, Python, or other frontend and scripting technologies.
* Azure DevOps, Jira, deployment pipelines, or operational handover.

  

We know that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed above. If you are excited about the role and believe you can contribute to the team, we encourage you to apply.

 **What’s in it for you?**


In this role, you will help create advanced IoT solutions with global impact while working closely with international teams and experienced technical colleagues. You will have the opportunity to grow as a technical leader, remain hands-on, and contribute to solutions that support efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.

* Build advanced IoT solutions used globally.
* Work with international teams and stakeholders.
* Develop your technical leadership and software expertise.
* Enjoy a collaborative environment with flexibility and work-life balance.

Jonas Falkvall, IoT Software Development Manager at jonas.falkvall@alfalaval.com or Raquel Herndon, Talent Acquisition Partner at raquel.herndon@alfalaval.com

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. title: Nanny + Content creator/admin
description:
**Om oss**

Vi är ett IT-företag som främst arbetar med webbdesign, utveckling och digital marknadsföring. För att förenkla och effektivisera vår vardag söker vi en person som trivs i en bred roll: 50% av tiden i hushållet med barnpassning och sysslor i hemmet, samt 50% på byrån med exempelvis content creation, administration, utveckling eller marknadsföring.

**Arbetsuppgifter**

1. **Hushåll fokus barn (50%)**

* Ta hand om barn (barnpassning, lek och enklare aktiviteter)
* Fixa vardagssysslor såsom att handla och laga lättare måltider
* Organisera och underhålla hemmet (plocka undan, hålla ordning, etc.)

2. **Content creator/admin (50%)**

Exempel på uppgifter, men vi anpassar det efter dina intressen:

* Skapa och uppdatera innehåll (text, bild, eventuell videoproduktion) på olika plattformar
* Hantera enklare administration, t.ex. fakturering, offertunderlag, kundkontakt
* Assistera i marknadsföring och säljprojekt, exempelvis utskick, kampanjer och sociala medier
* Hjälpa till i utvecklingsprojekt (t.ex. upplägg av innehåll i WordPress eller andra system)
* Bidra till interna processer, som att strukturera arbetsuppgifter, följa upp projekt m.m.

**Kvalifikationer - hushåll**

* Erfarenhet av barnpassning

**Kvalifikationer - adminstrativt**

Du behöver ingen utbildning eller erfarenhet, men intresse för att lära dig. Kanske har du jobbat med något helt annat tidigare och vill skola om. Eller kanske är du ny på arbetsmarknaden.

* Intresse för content creation, administration, marknadsföring, försäljning eller enklare webbutveckling
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och gärna engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Grundläggande datorkunskaper (kunna arbeta i Office-paketet, Google Workspace eller liknande)
* Meriterande om du har erfarenhet av CMS (t.ex. WordPress) eller grafiska program (t.ex. Canva eller Adobe Creative Cloud)

**Övrigt**:

* Du är snäll och gillar att leka med barn.
* Du är strukturerad, självgående och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter
* Du är social, kommunikativ och samarbetar bra i både familj- och byråmiljö
* Körkort B är ett plus (men inget krav)
* Du värdesätter ordning, är positiv och lösningsorienterad

**Omfattning och arbetstider**

* 50% hushåll/barnpassning + 50% arbete på kontor = 100% tjänst totalt
* Arbetstider dagtid, ej helg
* Exakta arbetstider och schema läggs upp tillsammans

**Vi erbjuder**

* En unik möjlighet att kombinera praktiskt hushållsarbete med kreativt och administrativt arbete på en webbyrå
* Variationsrika arbetsdagar och stor möjlighet att påverka din egen planering
* Ett familjärt och positivt arbetsklimat i både hemmiljö och byråmiljö
* Möjlighet till utveckling och att lära sig nya färdigheter inom digital marknadsföring, försäljning och webbutveckling

**Ansökan**

Ansök via InDeed med personligt brev. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Account Executive - Sweden
description:
**Account Executive**  

Stockholm, Sweden

 **About Puzzel**

We're the AI-native customer experience platform built in Norway, trusted across Europe, and growing fast. For 25 years we've helped contact centres deliver faster, more human service — without the clutter or complexity. Today we're #1 in the Nordics, scaling rapidly in the UK and the Netherlands, with one ambition: become Europe's clear CX market leader.

**Puzzel Values**

* **Built on Trust** - our Nordic foundation. Customers, partners, and each other.
* **Stronger Together** - one team, one purpose, shared wins.
* **Stay Hungry** - we raise our game every day.

**Why we’re proud**

* Frost Radar Innovation & Growth Leader in EMEA Customer Experience Platforms (2025)
* CX Awards 'Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform' (2024)
* Flexa Top 10 most inclusive companies and Top 25 for work-life balance, diversity and inclusion, pet-friendly companies and professional services (2026)
* Consistently high Glassdoor rating
* Mercer-benchmarked pay for equity and market fairness
* Puzzel doesn't just build AI for our customers — we’ve embraced it internally, adopting it across the business to work smarter and faster


Read more about us *here*.

**What you'll do**

This is a 100% net-new business role. You’ll drive your own prospecting, while working closely with our SDR, our partners and our marketing team to create and convert opportunities. Our SDR focuses on our top 100 accounts every day, marketing supports you with lead generation and events, and partners are an important source of new ARR in Sweden.


You’re proactive, solution-oriented and not afraid to shake things up. You communicate excellently, manage your own time and processes well, and know how to close deals.


You should have good time management skills, be comfortable running your own processes and excel at the following:

* Building and nurturing relationships with customers and partners or creating business opportunities from scratch - it's important to highlight that you'll be managing the full sales cycle from initial prospecting to close.
* Generate your own pipeline through outbound activity, spending a meaningful part of each week on direct and partner-led prospecting
* Collaborate with the SDR and marketing to turn target accounts, leads and events into qualified opportunities
* Recruit, enable and co-sell with partners and channel organisations to generate and close pipeline
* Run discovery calls, demos and presentations, building a thorough understanding of each customer’s needs, business and processes
* Take performance and budget responsibility for your own portfolio, driving growth and profitability
* Use our systems and automated sequences (Salesforce and Outreach in particular) to minimise manual work and follow RevOps best practice

**The must haves**

* Swedish native level speaker + strong English
* Technological understanding and interest in the field of cloud-based services
* At least 3 years’ experience managing full sales cycle, from prospect to close
* Proven outbound experience, and a track record of generating your own pipeline (ideally you still do your own outreach today)
* CX or complex B2B SaaS sales experience
* Experience working with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC and/or Challenger preferable) & sales pipelining
* Proactive, entrepreneurial mentality and willingness to self-generate pipeline are a must
* Autonomy and confidence to sell into a growing market

**The nice to haves**

* Experience of selling through partners or channels
* Exposure to an international environment
* Additional language skills
* CCaaS / competitor industry experience

**The location**


This role can be located in our Stockholm office, with a hybrid set up of 2-3 days/week in the office.

**What to expect from the interview process**

* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* 1st interview with Sales Director and Local Account Executive
* Final panel presentation

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We want everyone at Puzzel to feel able to be their true, authentic self at work – regardless of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical ability, age or economic background.


We're proud of our diverse, global workforce, but there's more to do. Our current gender split is 25% female to 75% male – in line with the SaaS average, but not where we want to be. Here's how we're improving it:

* Our C-suite has moved from 100% male in 2023 to a 5:3 male-to-female split today.
* Female hires grew from 23.6% in 2021 to 41% in 2024, dipping to 34% in 2025 — a trend we watch closely, but never treating as a tick-box exercise.
* We partner with Flexa, to compound our aspiration to attract a diverse talent pool.
* We work with state employment initiatives in Norway and Sweden on internship and apprenticeship routes, to help early-years talent into the workforce.

**One Last Thing**

Even if you're only a 75% match for this role, we still want to hear from you — this list is indicative, and skills can always be learnt.


We're unable to offer sponsorship for this role, so you'll need existing eligibility to work in the country you're applying to.

*By applying you accept the terms of our* *Data & Privacy notice**.*

-------------------


Requisition ID: 1757359
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.


We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.


Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

  

At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value - solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY's full spectrum of services, we have reimagined strategic consulting for a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.

  

EY-Parthenon is looking for Engagement Managers to join our Nordic Strategy & Execution team, leading Deal Technology work where technology is an investment thesis, a value creation lever and a transformation enabler, not just transaction support. This is more than a delivery role: deal technology is a fast-growing market with increasing demand, and our Nordic team is expanding rapidly. You will help build something bigger, from shaping our offering to growing our team, while advising clients on IT due diligence, carve-outs, integrations and technology-led value creation at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, private equity and corporate transactions.

  



**Your key responsibilities**

  

As an Engagement Manager, you will lead complex, time-critical engagements from scope to delivery. Working with senior executives, investors and M&A teams, you will connect technology, data and AI priorities with transaction logic, business value creation and long-term competitive advantage.

  

* Leading IT and technology due diligence engagements and communicating decision-relevant insights to senior stakeholders.
* Directing carve-out, separation and integration programmes, including TSA strategy, Day 1 readiness and governance.
* Shaping AI-enabled operating model transformation and technology-led growth initiatives across AI, data, cloud, digital platforms, applications and ERP.
* Managing engagement scope, delivery and risks while coaching consultants and building an inclusive, high-performing team.
  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* A relevant master's degree in business, economics, engineering, technology or a comparable field.
* Strong experience leading strategy or management consulting engagements, transaction advisory or complex technology-enabled change, and managing client relationships and multidisciplinary teams.
* The versatility to operate in both a CDO context (digital, data and AI) and a more traditional CIO context (core IT, ERP and infrastructure), connecting technology choices to financial, operational and strategic outcomes.
* Clear executive communication skills and fluency in English.
  

**Ideally, you will also have**

  

* Experience supporting business development, proposals and account growth.
* Experience working with private equity investors or corporate M&A functions in the Nordics, plus a Nordic language.
  

**What we offer you**

  

* Complex, high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in transaction environments.
* A collaborative, inclusive and entrepreneurial team culture with strong opportunities to learn and grow.
* Modern offices in central Stockholm and Gothenburg, with flexible ways of working.

Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.

  



**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**

  

Application deadline:22nd of November 2026. For questions about the recruitment process, contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com. Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

  

At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you need assistance or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.


Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.


EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

EY-Parthenon is looking for Senior Consultants to join our Nordic Strategy & Execution team, working on Deal Technology where technology is an investment thesis, a value creation lever and a transformation enabler, not just transaction support. This is more than a delivery role: deal technology is a fast-growing market with increasing demand, and our Nordic team is expanding rapidly. You will grow with it, from building your expertise to contributing to our offering, while supporting clients on IT due diligence, carve-outs, integrations and technology-led value creation at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, private equity and corporate transactions.

As a Senior Consultant, you will own defined workstreams within complex, time-critical engagements. Working with engagement managers, investors and M&A teams, you will turn technology, data and AI questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations that connect to transaction logic and business value creation.

  

* Conducting analyses and leading workstreams in IT and technology due diligence, and presenting decision-relevant insights to project leaders and clients.

* A relevant master's degree in business, economics, engineering, technology or a comparable field.
* Relevant experience from strategy or management consulting, transaction advisory, M&A or complex technology-enabled change, including working in client teams and delivering defined workstreams.
* Exposure to digital, data and AI or core IT, ERP and infrastructure, with an interest in developing across both areas and connecting technology choices to business outcomes.
* A structured, hands-on approach, strong analytical and communication skills, and fluency in English.
  

**Ideally, you will also have**

  

* Experience from technology or IT in transactions, separations or integrations, or knowledge of ERP, cloud, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data or AI in a deal context.
* Early experience of guiding junior colleagues or contributing to proposals and client opportunities.
* Experience working with private equity investors or corporate M&A functions in the Nordics, plus a Nordic language.
  

**What we offer you**

  

* Complex, high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in transaction environments.
* A collaborative, inclusive and entrepreneurial team culture with strong opportunities to learn and grow.
* Modern offices in central Stockholm and Gothenburg, with flexible ways of working.

Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.

  



**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**

  

Application deadline: 22nd of November 2026. For questions about the recruitment process, contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com. Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

  

At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you need assistance or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.


**EY | Building a better working world**

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.


Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.


EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: R&D Senior Configuration Manager
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


R&D Global Unit Lead
\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**


Are you passionate about bringing structure, control and traceability to complex software products? Join our Malmö R&D team as a Senior Configuration Manager and help shape how we manage software configurations throughout the product lifecycle from ongoing development to release and long-term maintenance.

  

Our teams develop control functionality for ABB System 800xA and next-generation automation products used in industrial applications, including the energy services industry. These products evolve over many years, with development taking place across parallel branches and multiple product releases. You will work closely with local developers and be part of ABB’s global Configuration Management (CM) team, contributing to the delivery of the complete automation system.

  

In this role, you will take ownership of clear, consistent CM practices. You will help ensure we can identify what is included in every release, understand and trace changes, reproduce delivered configurations and maintain our products with confidence. DevOps tools and automation are important enablers of this work, but configuration management is the core of the position.

  

Your main responsibilities will be to:

* Define, maintain and continuously improve CM plans, principles and working methods, including version control, branching and release management.
* Establish and maintain configuration identification, baselines and release records so software configurations and delivered versions are clearly defined, traceable and reproducible.
* Coordinate and support change control, ensuring changes are assessed, documented and introduced according to agreed procedures and release policies.
* Support release planning, configuration reviews and follow-up of CM status, working with developers and other stakeholders to maintain quality across product versions.
* Guide and coach colleagues in CM practices, promote common ways of working and help strengthen CM capabilities within the local team and ABB’s global CM community.
* Develop and improve the tools, build processes and CI/CD pipelines that support reliable integration, configuration control and software releases.
* Automate repetitive configuration, build and release tasks, and maintain relevant process documentation.

  

You will collaborate with software developers, technical leads and CM/DevOps colleagues across ABB. The role combines independent ownership of CM topics with practical teamwork and continuous improvement.

 **Qualifications for the role**


We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure in complex technical environments and can turn configuration management principles into effective everyday practices.

  

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Several years of experience in software configuration management, including configuration identification, change control, baselines and release management.
* Good understanding of Git-based version control, branching strategies and the management of software across parallel development and product releases.
* Experience working with development teams and using or improving CI/CD and build processes, for example with Azure DevOps.
* A structured and analytical approach, good communication skills and the ability to coordinate, explain and improve practices across teams.

  

In addition, it is advantageous if you have experience with:

  

* Scripting, automation and development tooling (e.g., Python, Bash), plus containerization, cloud or infrastructure as code (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Azure).
* Industrial automation, long-lifecycle products, large-scale distributed systems or safety-critical development (for example IEC 61508).

 **More about us**


Recruiting Manager Ali Houmani, +46 72 461 43 24 will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: Kenneth Hultman, +46 703 49 60 95; Ledarna: Leif Öhrberg, +46 724 64 40 16; Unionen: Mikael Hammar, +46 730 887 060. All other questions can be directed to Talent Partner Irma Leijon, +46 724 612 314.

  

ABB is a major provider of power and automation technologies. Our solutions improve the efficiency, productivity and quality of our customers’ operations while minimizing environmental impact. Innovation is at the forefront of what we do and many of the technologies that drive modern society were developed by ABB.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.




Ready to make an impact?


Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Senior Solution Architect, Automotive Connectivity
description:
**About Aeris Communications Inc.**  

Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices. It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30+ mobile network operators. Enterprises rely on Aeris for the borderless connectivity, embedded security, observability, and proven scale that mission critical Physical AI programs demand.

 **The Opportunity**  

  

The Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive Connectivity is a strategic technical role at the intersection of automotive engineering, telecommunications, cloud platforms, and IoT. You will serve as the primary technical counterpart to automotive OEM engineering and IT teams, translating Aeris platform capabilities into compelling, architecturally sound solutions that address OEM connectivity challenges.
This is not a traditional pre-sales engineering role. You will operate as a technical strategist — shaping how Aeris engages with OEMs, influencing product direction, creating differentiated technical narratives, and building the technical foundation for long-term OEM partnerships.


You will work across two Aeris business units (Automotive Business Unit and IoT Business Unit), requiring fluency in multiple platform architectures and the ability to compose cross-platform solutions.

 **Key Responsibilities**


Technical Sales Engagement

* Serve as the lead technical resource in OEM pre-sales engagements, RFI/RFP responses, solution presentations, and architecture workshops
* Design and present solution architectures that map Aeris capabilities to OEM connectivity requirements
* Develop and deliver compelling technical demonstrations, proofs of concept, and pilot designs
* Engage directly with OEM technical stakeholders including connectivity architects, telematics engineers, platform engineering leads, cybersecurity teams, and procurement


Solution Architecture & Design

* Architect end-to-end connected vehicle solutions spanning connectivity management, eSIM lifecycle management (SGP.22/SGP.32), device management, data ingestion, and vehicle operations
* Design integration architectures connecting Aeris platforms (AMP, Neo, Watchtower) with OEM backend systems, TSPs, MNOs, and cloud environments
* Define and document technical solution proposals, integration specifications, and architecture decision records
* Evaluate and recommend approaches for multi-MNO strategies, regional connectivity models, and roaming optimization


Product Strategy Support

* Translate OEM technical requirements and competitive gaps into structured product requirements and recommendations
* Collaborate with Product Management to prioritize automotive-specific platform enhancements
* Maintain a living competitive technical analysis covering key competitors (Harman Ignite, Ericsson, Cisco/Kigen, G+D, Thales, etc.)
* Identify emerging technology trends (SDV, vehicle-to-cloud, Android Automotive, zonal architectures) and assess implications for Aeris product strategy


Knowledge Development & Enablement

* Develop and maintain a technical knowledge base for Automotive Connectivity including solution architectures, reference designs, integration patterns, competitive comparisons, and technical FAQ
* Create reusable technical assets: solution briefs, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, white papers, and technical blog content
* Enable broader Sales and Sales Engineering teams on automotive connectivity concepts, Aeris differentiators, and OEM engagement best practices
* Document OEM-specific technical landscapes, integration requirements, and architecture preferences


Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Service Delivery and Professional Services teams to ensure solution designs are implementable and supportable
* Partner with the Automotive Connectivity Strategy Lead to align technical positioning with business strategy
* Support Marketing with technically grounded content for thought leadership, analyst engagements, and conference presentations
* Participate in industry standards discussions and working groups as appropriate (GSMA, 5GAA, etc.)

 **Requirements**


Experience

* Senior experience in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, systems engineering, or technical consulting
* 3+ years working in or with the automotive industry — specifically connected vehicles, telematics, V2X, or automotive connectivity
* Direct experience with eSIM technologies (SGP.02, SGP.22, SGP.32) — architecture, provisioning flows, and ecosystem participants (SM-DP+, SM-DS, eIM, ECS, LPA)
* Experience with connectivity management platforms and/or IoT platform architectures
* Demonstrated experience engaging with enterprise or OEM technical stakeholders at the architecture and engineering level
* Experience with MNO ecosystems, MVNO models, roaming, and multi-carrier connectivity strategies


Technical Skills

title: Embedded Software consultant
description:

* An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
* Supportive and coaching leadership.
* The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.

* Experience in low-level embedded software development.

title: Senior security engineer
description:
### **Greetings**


Hello and Welcome. Let’s be honest, marketing is not our passion, IT Security is. We aren’t looking for a standard consultant who just wants to clock in and out. We are looking for someone who is a “Blue Geek” at heart, who knows the difference between AMCache and Prefetch, and who would rather work at a company where we discuss shell bags and car license plates than sit through generic sales pitches.

##### **Who are we?**


We are Venor. We help our partners protect their systems without compromising on productivity. We are completely self-funded and have never brought in outside financing, we value our freedom and neutrality.


At Venor, transparency is key. Curious about a peer’s salary? Just ask. We make uncommon levels of information available internally, but we never share customer data. We don’t have a sect-like culture where we lift our CEO to the ceiling like maniacs, but we do have a culture where we support each other when it counts (ask us about “The Sec-T incident”)

##### **Your Mission:**


As a Senior Venorian, you will have a role where you get your hands dirty. When things go south, we don’t turn it off and on again; we work to resolve issue.


You will enjoy a high degree of autonomy working on long-term projects with demanding customers, mixed with inhouse technical innovation. We create stuff exactly how we want it.

##### **Your quests include:**

* **Incident Response & Forensics**: Lead IR efforts and perform deep forensic analysis when our partners get breached (or better yet, prevent them from getting breached in the first place).
* **Detection Engineering**: Build and improve log flows, queries and pipelines. We don’t settle for generic solutions to specific problems.
* **Cloud & Architecture**: Work with security architecture and incident handling in AWS/GCP/Azure and Kubernetes Security.
* **Threat Intelligence**: Monitor the ever-changing threat landscape and analyse new TTPs. You ensure we are updated and always one step ahead of the galactic adversaries.
* **Technical Advisory**: Act as a strategic support and technical advisor.
* **Innovation**: Code automations, bots, and custom tools (Python/PowerShell) to strengthen our MDR services.
* **Mentorship**: Support the next generation of Venorians. We believe in "Hire for attitude, train for skill", and you will be a key part of their development.

##### **Who are you? (Character Stats)**


We believe that everything you are interested in, you can learn, but for this specific role, you need to have levelled up a bit already.

* **Level**: You have 5+ years of experience in Blue Team, IR, forensics, or cloud security.
* **Skills**: You can script in Python or PowerShell and have a deep understanding of logs,
* detection technology and/or forensics.
* **Mindset**: You want more technical breadth than in a traditional SOC. You are humble ("Be Spock, not a Klingon") and enjoy sharing knowledge.
* **Bonus**: It doesn't hurt if you relate to bullets like "0118999881999119725…3", "42", or know what to find in $MFT.

##### **Why Venor? (Loot & Buffs)**


We don't just say we have fun; we prove it through L.A.I.R. (our monthly lab and research days) and S.W.O.R.D. (working together from the office) as well as offsites twice a year where we have focus on a specific theme.

* Development: A dedicated education budget of 150,000 SEK over two years to ensure you stay one step ahead of galactic adversaries.
* Benefits: Opportunity to buy stocks, 30 days of vacation (+1 extra day per employed year), health insurance, ITP1 like pension, and a wellness contribution of ~5000 SEK/year.
* Balance: Flexible work hours and free disposal bridge days. Life happens (dentist, marriage, relocation), and we support that.

##### **Ready to beam aboard?**


Join the crew Are you ready to make adversaries across the galaxy worry? About us? If you feel like


a Venorian, let us know.


So long, and thanks for all the fish / Dif tor heh smusma

title: Lead Automation Engineer DM & DX
description:
Scania genomgår en transformation från att vara en ledande leverantör av lastbilar, bussar och motorer till att erbjuda kompletta och hållbara transportlösningar. Tillsammans med TRATON och våra systermärken MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus och International arbetar vi för att forma framtidens mobilitet med innovativa och miljömedvetna lösningar.
  

  

Våra värderingar – kunden först, respekt, laganda, ansvar och eliminering av slöseri – genomsyrar allt vi gör. Tillsammans står vi i framkant för att skapa en hållbar framtid.


**Om rollen**
-------------

  

Som Lead Automation Engineer (LAE) för DM och DX får du ett sammanhållet tekniskt ansvar för automation och SCADA inom Engine Manufacturing & Foundry och Transmission Manufacturing. Du blir länken mellan produktionens behov, lokala Automation Engineers, projekt, leverantörer, Software Architects och centrala produktteam.


Ditt uppdrag är att säkerställa att lokala behov omsätts till säkra, hållbara och supportbara lösningar i linje med Scanias arkitektur och globala produkter. Du leder tekniskt utan personalansvar och kombinerar lokal processförståelse med ett långsiktigt, globalt perspektiv. Rollen innebär att skapa återanvändbara lösningar samtidigt som du säkerställer stabilitet, kvalitet och framtidens tillverkning.


**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------------------------

  

* Äga och kommunicera den tekniska riktningen för automation och SCADA inom DM och DX.
* Utvärdera behov, gap och avvikelser samt rekommendera om lösningar ska konfigureras, utvecklas lokalt eller hanteras i en global produkt.
* Definiera high-level design och kvalitetssäkra arkitektur, MEC-specifikationer, integrationer och teknisk dokumentation.
* Leda den tekniska omfattningen genom FIT, FAT, integrationstest, SAT, driftsättning och överlämning.
* Ge teknisk vägledning, coaching och designstöd till Automation Engineers och utvecklare.
* Säkerställa att lokala lösningar har tydligt ägarskap, en långsiktig plan samt krav på IT/OT-säkerhet, backup och återställning.
* Representera DM och DX gentemot centrala produktteam, arkitekturfunktioner och relevanta leverantörer.
**Vem är du?**
--------------

  

Du är en erfaren teknisk ledare som skapar riktning och förtroende utan att vara beroende av formellt mandat. Du kan växla mellan dagens produktionskritiska problem och den långsiktiga arkitekturen, och du utmanar kortsiktiga lösningar på ett konstruktivt sätt.


Vi ser gärna att du har:


* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom automation, elektroteknik, datateknik eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av industriell automation och SCADA i en komplex produktionsmiljö.
* God förståelse för och programmeringskompetens inom PLC, industriella nätverk och integrationer mellan utrustning, SCADA, MES och övriga IT-system.
* God kunskap om och förståelse för SQL Server.
* Erfarenhet av teknisk design, test, commissioning och livscykelhantering.
* Förmåga att kommunicera med produktion, underhåll, engineering, IT-specialister, projekt och ledning.
* God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Du har god logisk och teknisk förståelse för AI:s möjligheter inom automation och systemutveckling. Du ser hur tekniken kan förändra arbetssätten och tar initiativ till att pröva, utvärdera och omsätta AI-stöd i praktiska förbättringar med bibehållen säkerhet och kvalitet. Denna förståelse och vilja att utveckla arbetssätten är ett krav.


**Vilka är vi?**
----------------

  

Du arbetar nära produktionen inom DM och DX och blir en central del av ett tvärfunktionellt IT-samarbete. Rollen innebär nära samverkan med Automation Engineers, utvecklare, projekt, underhåll, engineering, arkitekturfunktioner, centrala produktteam och relevanta leverantörer. Vi delar kunskap, tar ett gemensamt ansvar för stabil produktion och utvecklar lösningar som fungerar både lokalt och i Scanias globala struktur.


**Scania erbjuder**
-------------------

  

Vi erbjuder en dynamisk och engagerande arbetsplats där samarbete, innovation och ständiga förbättringar är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du blir en del av en stark teamkultur som uppmuntrar kunskapsdelning och nära samarbete mellan olika funktioner.


Med en strukturerad utvecklingsplan och ett brett utbud av utbildningar stödjer Scania din professionella utveckling både lokalt och internationellt.


Förmåner inkluderar tillgång till vårt hälsocenter i Gröndal eller friskvårdsbidrag, resultatbonus, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet till förmånsbil. Scania arrangerar även aktiviteter för medarbetare och deras familjer, och för dig som bor i Stockholm finns smidig pendling via Scania Job express-bussar till Södertälje.


**Ansökan**
